name: ClientHub
author: NETT.PRO

sections.description:
ClientHub helps freelancers and agencies manage clients inside WordPress: keep contact details in one place, track project progress, and give each client a secure portal to view their projects and message you.

Included in this release:

  • Client records linked to WordPress user accounts
  • Project tracking with progress and dates
  • Admin and client messaging
  • Front-end portal via the [clienthub] shortcode
  • Email notifications for new projects, project updates, and new client messages
  • Dedicated Client Portal User role for portal access
  • Responsive admin and portal styling

Premium (optional): Quotes, invoices, and advanced reporting are available from NETT.PRO and are clearly marked in the admin dashboard. They are not part of the free WordPress.org plugin.

Whether you manage a handful of clients or a growing roster, ClientHub keeps day-to-day communication and project status in one place without leaving WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clienthub folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘ClientHub’ in your WordPress admin panel
  4. Add your first client and create projects
  5. Use the shortcode [clienthub] on any page to display the client portal
sections.faq:
Can I customize the look of the client portal?

The portal uses the plugin’s built-in styles so it works with most themes. Advanced branding (colors, logo, white-label) is part of ClientHub Premium. You can still style the portal with your theme’s custom CSS if needed.

Is ClientHub compatible with my theme?

ClientHub is designed to work with most WordPress themes. The plugin uses WordPress coding standards and follows best practices for compatibility.

How secure is the client data?

ClientHub uses WordPress’s built-in security features including nonce verification, secure password hashing, and role-based access control. Clients only see their own projects and messages when logged in through the portal.

Can clients access their own portal?

Yes. Each client has a WordPress user account and can log in on the page where you placed the [clienthub] shortcode to view projects, send messages, and update profile settings.

Do I need coding knowledge to use ClientHub?

No. Install, activate, add clients, create a portal page with the shortcode, and you are ready to go.

Does the free plugin include file sharing?

Not yet. File sharing and document libraries are planned for a future release (and are highlighted as Premium on the dashboard). This readme describes only what the current free version provides.
